# on 2026-08-17; repo commit 7a5d339; gcc 15.2.0; python3 3.14.4
#
# NOT regenerated by archive.sh: the baseline arm at n=50 spends
# 11,906,349,370 steps and takes minutes, and the prototype needs a per-site
# minrest that is not the two-level formula (k23_design.md section 2.6).
#
# Reproduce:
#   build/pcrec -p rx --emit-main --step-budget=1000000000000 -o l3.c \
#       '((a{2,4}){5,10}){5,20}'
#   python3 probes/prune_proto.py l3.c l3p.c --outer-min 0 --inner-min 0 \
#       --stride 1 --replicas 200 \
#       --minrest-py 'max(0,5-((k%10)+1))*2 + max(0,5-((k//10)+1))*10'
#   ... then instrument both as probes/steps.sh does and run.
#
# columns: arm  n  steps  span  group1  group2
baseline  50   11906349370   0 50   40 50   48 50
prune     50             6   0 50   40 50   48 50
prune     51             6   0 51   41 51   49 51
prune     55             6   0 55   45 55   53 55
prune     60             6   0 60   50 60   58 60
prune    100             5   0 100  90 100  98 100
#
# The python oracle does not return on this shape inside 100 s at n = 50, so
# the correctness check here is pcrec-vs-pcrec (replication as ground truth,
